scenicChapters.title: Kalkalpen - Hintergebirg → Kalkalpen - Urlach
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: McKenzie Pass Santiam Pass Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 21 km this is McKenzie Pass Santiam Pass Scenic Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
